name: God Helmet: amygdala both sides, then hippocampus right (60 min)
origin: Todd Murphy (Shiva God Helmet software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's two-phase Shiva God Helmet session, 30 + 30 min: the amygdala burst-firing signal stepped around both temporal lobes, then the hippocampal 'LTP' signal around the right one. The vendor expects 'deep calm, inner images, and possibly a sense of spaciousness' in phase 2. The one lab run (3 people, no sham group) reports no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4).
notes: The vendor's page states no length for this session (general rule: 20 to 30 min per phase, index.htm). Persinger's lab ran it once: 20 + 20 min, 3 people, no sham, no clear pattern of experiences (Collins 2014, ch. 4, condition 7; program persinger-collins-gh-c7-amybi-hippr). This file runs 30 + 30 min. Neither vendor signal is published, so both are rebuilt. Amygdala: this project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length, 289 points of 3 ms = 867 ms, then 4 s of silence (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]); the point values were never published. Hippocampus: the primed burst drawn in Corradini 2014 Fig. 2 (p.103 [92]), 5-ms pulses at 0, 150, 164, 178 and 192 ms, five times in 1 s, then 4 s of silence. In phase 1 one left-right pair is on at a time, and the right side is reversed so that the pair's field points through the head. The four sites per side stand for the lab helmet's four solenoids per side on a 7.5 by 5 cm ellipse; the site names are this project's reading. Each coil is held 125 ms, a project choice (vendor: 'several times per second'). No God Helmet page states a field; the lab measured 1 to 2 uT in the centre of the cap (Collins 2014 p.69 [60]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Fear or anxiety in phase 1: use the abort button to move on to phase 2, as the vendor says. In phase 2: stop and never reuse this session. Not for people prone to anxiety. Headache or pressure (vendor: about 2% with the hippocampal signal): lower the intensity by a third. Vendor exclusions: epilepsy or seizures, psychiatric conditions or medication, migraine, brain injury, drugs. Stop on any distress.
setting: Darkness and acoustic silence (the vendor: 'silence, not just quiet'), blindfold or eyes closed; sit or lie relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. The vendor prefers night sessions on geomagnetically quiet days and a helper who can stop the session. No meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor rules: God Helmet sessions at most weekly; after six sessions, stop for 21 days (the vendor's God Helmet safety page). For 60-minute sessions the Shiva pages say weekly or every two weeks and the Shakti pages at most every 3 weeks; the longer gap is the cautious choice. The rule 'NEVER do the same session two days in a row' is from the vendor's Shakti pages. Do not mix with Shiva or Shakti sessions in the same weeks; try a session 2 to 3 times before changing it.
